content.title: Guidance and Planning Documents
content.summary: The city government has developed several planning documents to guide park and trail development, including the 2016 Parks, Trails and Open Space Master Plan, the 2017 Bicycle Master Plan, the 2019 Clear Creek Corridor Plan, and the Blunn Pioneer Master Plan Final Report. These documents outline strategies for enhancing recreational spaces and promoting sustainable transportation options within the community.
